records.text: No row has a mandatory prerequisite. Consumers start from existing work or stated behavior, reading earlier outputs when recorded; the AI orders selected producers and consumers. Forced edges had made hover timing run a website direction.

Its font list, hero gradient, Tailwind scale and tagline reveal had been scoped out only because the two sources contradicted each other; with no collision left they apply as written (ADR-0017). records.text: claude-design-system-prompt (2026-11-12, head 3c3ddb07): a system prompt of twenty chapters and fourteen skills become seven roles loaded on demand. No text or hook from this source is session-wide (`delivery.json`): its persona, non-disclosure and chat-conduct lines and its own skill routing are dropped, its domain rules live in the bodies and the prompt file is not shipped. Merged: the five review skills into design-review (polish runs the other four on one file); variations/tweak panel into design-options; both extracts into design-system-extract; questions into briefs. aesthetic-direction conflicts with visual-direction (two owners of palette and type) and is a `needs` of ui-prototype and html-deck only when nothing gives a look. html-deck and office-deck differ by wanted format; unspecified stays office-deck. A motion-spec overrides the transition band; design-guidance stays lookup/report. Eval: 32 of 33 historically; db-migration was later corrected as in scope.

records.text: ponytail v5.3.3 and i-have-adhd v0.4.1 (2026-11-12): one permanent policy that carries both in their own words; three marked lines let them coexist with the catalog. Ponytail enriches work-map; review/audit share engineering-review; shortcut ledgers use engineering-debt; method/benchmark explanations use engineering-guidance. No forced prerequisite or duplicate output owner. i-have-adhd adds no procedure. delivery.json explains exclusions of source mode controls, UI and telemetry. Originals carried as text are intake-only; the benchmark travels. Native policy needs the complete adapter, acts before classification and creates no step for style alone.

records.text: superpowers v7.0.2 (2026-11-14): the planning chain in symbiosis with EGM — a design-doc or brief is the spec impl-plan argues from; the two executors are one role (plan-execution; the source shares their workspace and ledger) with the required method texts packaged as the step's files. using-superpowers, its SessionStart hook and brainstorming are dropped or evidence-only: self-activating routing competes with the coordinator and concept-brief owns the idea stage (`delivery.json`). work-map keeps plan-less implementation; engineering-review keeps standalone code review; fresh-review reviews the plan as a document.

records.text: zero-slop-design v0.2.1 (2026-11-17): fourteen skills, four on-demand roles, nothing session-wide. design-file is the only writer of the brief and `DESIGN.md`; apply, inspection (report-only; its drift output is not `drift_report`) and integration (token export, code checks in CI) read it; no forced chain. Look authority, owner decision: the user's request in the turn, then a project `DESIGN.md` that is not a starter or a reference (minus `unresolved` and `proposed`), then tokens or a Master in the repository, then a direction recorded in the plan; candidates stay proposals. For visual-direction such a file is the user's explicit instruction; no building or reviewing step rewrites it. Its ban on unrequested tests governs interface checks in its steps; Ponytail's self-check for new logic and plan-execution's TDD stand.
records.author: muro
